SELECT hra.chance_id, hra.document_name, hra.chance_attachment_id, hra.description, hra.attachment_category, -- hra.upload_date, (select wm_concat(fa.attachment_id) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name in ('HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE','HLS_CREDIT_CHANCE_DOCX') and to_char(hra.CHANCE_ATTACHMENT_ID) = fam.table_pk_value) attachment_id, (select wm_concat(fa.file_name) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name in ('HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE','HLS_CREDIT_CHANCE_DOCX') and to_char(hra.CHANCE_ATTACHMENT_ID) = fam.table_pk_value) file_name, /* (SELECT su.DESCRIPTION FROM sys_user su WHERE hra.UPLOAD_PERSON = su.user_id) upload_person_n,*/ (select max(fa.created_by) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name in ('HLS_CREDIT_LINE_ATTACH', 'HLS_CREDIT_CHANCE_DOCX') and to_char(hra.CHANCE_ATTACHMENT_ID) = fam.table_pk_value) upload_person, (SELECT su.DESCRIPTION FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = (select max(fa.created_by) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name in ('HLS_CREDIT_LINE_ATTACH', 'HLS_CREDIT_CHANCE_DOCX') and to_char(hra.CHANCE_ATTACHMENT_ID) = fam.table_pk_value)) upload_person_n, (select max(fa.creation_date) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name in ('HLS_CREDIT_LINE_ATTACH', 'HLS_CREDIT_CHANCE_DOCX') and to_char(hra.CHANCE_ATTACHMENT_ID) = fam.table_pk_value) upload_date, hra.status, nvl2((select distinct necessary_upload_flag from sys_document_list sdl where sdl.document_category = 'PRJ_CHANCE' and hra.document_name = sdl.document_list_name), 'Y', 'N') necessary_upload_flag, case when hra.document_name = '立项申请表' then 0 else 1 end as ordernum FROM hls_credit_line_attach hra
hra.CHANCE_ID = nvl(#{chanceId},-99)
order by ordernum
